definition: Centered natural-image PCA, descending variance; all rows predetermined before test observations

preprocessing.resize: PIL ImageOps.fit centered aspect crop then LANCZOS resize from 256 source, grayscale /255; no native rectangular training detail

pca_center: empirical mean of all training images; decoder mean unchanged
algorithm: CPU-block streamed randomized subspace SVD; approximate top components
selection: max mean physical-row cosine with PCA direction, per predetermined block; no Q/current measurements
